israeli_gaza_stakeholders: Netanyahu formally pleads not guilty.

other_uk_stakeholders: Arnon Milchan gives evidence remotely from Brighton, placing part of the Israeli corruption proceeding physically within the UK.

other_uk_stakeholders: The UK begins responding diplomatically and operationally to the attacks and ensuing war.
us_trump_and_associates: The Biden administration, rather than the later Trump administration, begins the immediate US response.

labour_labour_together: The Sunday Times scrutinises Labour Together's undeclared donations and internal operation. This reporting later becomes the subject of APCO's 'Operation Cannon' work.
other_uk_stakeholders: British journalists and media organisations begin the scrutiny that later becomes part of the 2026 controversy.
israeli_gaza_stakeholders: The Gaza war continues while Netanyahu's corruption trial remains pending.
analytical_note: Opening point for the Labour Together accountability strand.

israeli_gaza_stakeholders: The court reduces Netanyahu trial hearings to two days a week because of wartime security concerns.

regional_military_actions_cross_border_s: US airstrikes hit IRGC- and militia-linked targets in Iraq and Syria; nearly 40 deaths are reported.
analytical_note: Early marker showing that the post-7 October conflict had already spread beyond Israel and Gaza.

other_uk_stakeholders: The UK assists in intercepting some Iranian drones and missiles.
us_trump_and_associates: The Biden administration assists Israel's defence but presses against immediate escalation.
israeli_gaza_stakeholders: Iran launches a large direct drone-and-missile attack on Israel after the strike on its diplomatic compound in Damascus.
regional_military_actions_cross_border_s: First major direct Iranian attack launched from Iranian territory against Israel; interceptions involve Israel, the US, UK, France and regional states.
analytical_note: Marks the shift from proxy confrontation to overt Iran-Israel exchange.

us_trump_and_associates: Washington publicly urges restraint.
israeli_gaza_stakeholders: Israel conducts a limited retaliatory strike near Isfahan in Iran.
regional_military_actions_cross_border_s: Israeli retaliation reaches Iranian territory.

israeli_gaza_stakeholders: The prosecution completes its case; the defence phase is expected to begin with Netanyahu's own testimony.

us_trump_and_associates: The Biden administration manages alliance and escalation risks as Israel intensifies operations in Lebanon.

regional_military_actions_cross_border_s: Israel sharply expands its Lebanon campaign, striking Beirut and Hezbollah infrastructure.
analytical_note: A major widening of the war into Lebanon.

israeli_gaza_stakeholders: Israel strikes Houthi targets at Yemen's Hodeidah port while continuing attacks in Lebanon.
regional_military_actions_cross_border_s: Israeli military operations simultaneously encompass Lebanon and Yemen.
sudan_south_sudan_horn_gulf_spillover: Red Sea infrastructure and Gulf maritime-security interests become more tightly connected to the Israel-Gaza war.

us_trump_and_associates: US forces assist Israeli air defence.
israeli_gaza_stakeholders: Iran launches a second large missile attack on Israel.
regional_military_actions_cross_border_s: A further direct Iran-Israel exchange follows the killing of senior Hezbollah and Hamas figures.

us_trump_and_associates: The Biden administration is informed ahead of the operation and urges limits on escalation.
israeli_gaza_stakeholders: Israel strikes Iranian air-defence and missile-production targets.
regional_military_actions_cross_border_s: Israeli aircraft conduct a large direct operation against military targets inside Iran.

israeli_gaza_stakeholders: Netanyahu begins testifying in his own defence while serving as prime minister and conducting the Gaza war.
analytical_note: The first sitting Israeli prime minister to take the witness stand as a criminal defendant.

other_uk_stakeholders: British individuals and institutions connected to Epstein remain exposed to renewed disclosure risk.

analytical_note: First Trump-administration Epstein release in this chronology.

analytical_note: South Sudan enters the timeline as a distinct but structurally adjacent regional crisis.

other_uk_stakeholders: The UK faces renewed Red Sea security and shipping implications.

israeli_gaza_stakeholders: The Houthis describe their Red Sea campaign as support for Palestinians in Gaza.
regional_military_actions_cross_border_s: US strikes begin across Houthi-controlled Yemen, opening a sustained campaign.
sudan_south_sudan_horn_gulf_spillover: The campaign reinforces the Red Sea as a shared theatre connecting Gulf security, Yemen, the Horn and global shipping.

us_trump_and_associates: The US urges South Sudanese President Salva Kiir to release Riek Machar.
sudan_south_sudan_horn_gulf_spillover: Riek Machar is placed under house arrest. His party says the detention effectively collapses the peace deal; the government says he will be investigated for attempting to stir rebellion.

us_trump_and_associates: Trump announces that the US will stop bombing the Houthis after an Oman-mediated agreement concerning attacks on shipping.
israeli_gaza_stakeholders: The agreement does not necessarily end Houthi action directed specifically at Israel.
regional_military_actions_cross_border_s: US-Yemen bombing pause begins.
sudan_south_sudan_horn_gulf_spillover: Oman's mediation demonstrates the Gulf monarchies' role as both participants in and shock absorbers for regional escalation.

israeli_gaza_stakeholders: State prosecutors begin cross-examining Netanyahu.

other_uk_stakeholders: The UK manages evacuation, airspace and alliance implications.

israeli_gaza_stakeholders: Israel launches major strikes against Iranian nuclear, military and leadership targets.
regional_military_actions_cross_border_s: The Iran-Israel confrontation escalates into sustained direct warfare.
sudan_south_sudan_horn_gulf_spillover: Gulf states confront airspace, energy-market and base-security risks.

regional_military_actions_cross_border_s: US airstrikes hit Iranian nuclear sites, followed by a fragile ceasefire.
sudan_south_sudan_horn_gulf_spillover: The confrontation affects Gulf bases, energy routes and regional diplomatic alignments.

israeli_gaza_stakeholders: The court cancels that week's hearings after previously rejecting Netanyahu's request for a two-week delay based on diplomatic and security demands.
analytical_note: Illustrates repeated interaction between official security duties and the trial timetable.

regional_military_actions_cross_border_s: First known lethal strike in the Trump administration's escalating Caribbean operation near Venezuela.
analytical_note: Shows the administration opening a separate kinetic theatre in the Caribbean.

us_trump_and_associates: Trump says he is unhappy about the operation; senior US officials engage Qatar after the strike.
israeli_gaza_stakeholders: Israel attacks Hamas political leaders in Doha, Qatar, despite Qatar's role as a ceasefire mediator.
regional_military_actions_cross_border_s: The Gaza conflict expands into the territory of a Gulf monarchy and major US partner.
sudan_south_sudan_horn_gulf_spillover: The strike places Gulf mediation, sovereignty and security guarantees under direct stress.
South Sudan charges Riek Machar with murder, treason and crimes against humanity and suspends him as first vice president, escalating the Kiir-Machar rupture.

us_trump_and_associates: US forces conduct repeated lethal strikes on vessels near Venezuela, including strikes announced on 3, 14 and 16 October.
regional_military_actions_cross_border_s: The Caribbean maritime campaign expands through multiple strikes and rising reported deaths.

israeli_gaza_stakeholders: Israel and Hamas sign or accept the first phase of the Gaza ceasefire and hostage-prisoner arrangement.

sudan_south_sudan_horn_gulf_spillover: The UAE calls for a ceasefire and civilian transition in Sudan while Sudan's army continues to accuse it of supporting the RSF with weaponry and fighters; the UAE denies the allegations.
analytical_note: A clear marker for the Gulf-monarchy layer in the Sudan conflict.

analytical_note: Publication precedes the statutory Epstein deadline and the February 2026 Labour Together crisis.

labour_labour_together: Paul Holden's book is published on the same date as this Sudan escalation marker.
sudan_south_sudan_horn_gulf_spillover: Sudan's RSF shifts operations eastward after consolidating control in Darfur, with renewed violence, drone attacks and mobilisation around oil-producing southern areas.
analytical_note: Connects Sudan's war to oil infrastructure and the South Sudan border economy.

other_uk_stakeholders: British Epstein-linked stakeholders face a new statutory US disclosure timetable.

analytical_note: Starts the statutory disclosure clock.

us_trump_and_associates: Reuters reports that the US is preparing a new phase of Venezuela operations after months of Caribbean military buildup and Trump authorisation of covert CIA activity.
regional_military_actions_cross_border_s: Venezuela pressure moves from isolated maritime strikes toward broader covert and military operations.

israeli_gaza_stakeholders: Netanyahu asks President Isaac Herzog for a pardon while his corruption trial remains unfinished; the request contains no admission of guilt.
analytical_note: The pardon track overlaps the Epstein statutory timetable.

israeli_gaza_stakeholders: Netanyahu says that receiving a pardon would not cause him to leave politics.

other_uk_stakeholders: British Epstein-linked individuals remain exposed while disclosure is incomplete.

israeli_gaza_stakeholders: Netanyahu's criminal trial and pardon request remain unresolved.
analytical_note: Key missed or incomplete-compliance deadline in the US track.

regional_military_actions_cross_border_s: US military action continues in Syria during the same period as the Epstein statutory deadline.

us_trump_and_associates: Trump orders US strikes against Islamic State-linked targets in northwest Nigeria, with Nigerian government coordination.
regional_military_actions_cross_border_s: A further US kinetic theatre opens in West Africa.

us_trump_and_associates: US forces capture Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro and his wife in a military operation; Trump says the US will run Venezuela during a transition.
regional_military_actions_cross_border_s: The Caribbean campaign escalates into direct regime-removal and capture operations on Venezuelan territory.
analytical_note: Legality is disputed by international-law experts.

sudan_south_sudan_horn_gulf_spillover: South Sudan's government warns that an opposition advance and fighting in Jonglei threaten to reignite civil war and have already caused mass displacement.

israeli_gaza_stakeholders: Netanyahu's trial and pardon process remain live.
analytical_note: Central release point for the January-February 2026 cascade.

analytical_note: Two days after the Labour Together/APCO story breaks.

The Labour government loses another senior centre-of-government figure during the developing crisis.

Starmer orders a ministerial-standards investigation into Josh Simons. Peter Mandelson is arrested on suspicion of misconduct in public office.
